services.desc: Experience the thrill of riding across Cape Cod’s beautiful coastline on a guided jet ski adventure. This is more than just a rental-it’s a fully supervised water experience designed for safety, fun, and unforgettable moments on the ocean. Jet skiing with Provincetown Watersports combines excitement with structure and safety. You’ll enjoy the freedom of riding across open water while being supported by our experienced crew the entire time. Whether you’re a first-time rider or returning guest, our guided experience ensures you feel confident, safe, and ready to enjoy the ride.
